name: CHEF'S KISS
source:
"I'll always kiss you–even with the blade of my knife."

Sometimes you wish your life wasn't so boring. Wake up, go to work, come home, repeat. Sometimes wishes come true in unintended ways.

[From [url=https://grubworm3.itch.io/chefs-kiss]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“我会永远吻你——即使用我的刀刃。”

有时你希望自己的生活不要那么无聊。起床，上班，回家，如此重复。有时愿望会以意想不到的方式实现。

[来自[url=https://grubworm3.itch.io/chefs-kiss]Itch.io[/url]]
